title: Bamboo Staff
description: Adds a craftable staff made of bamboo that lets you attack with more reach, knockback, and speed.
body:
### Bamboo Staff
This mod adds a bamboo staff that you can craft with 3 pieces of bamboo placed diagonally in the crafting table. The bamboo staff does 2 hearts of damage and has extra reach, knockback, and attack speed. It can be upgrade to a master bamboo staff by placing 3 bamboo staffs diagonally in the crafting table, netherite scrap in the remaining corners, and gold ingots in the rest of the spaces. The master bamboo staff does more damage and has even more reach, knockback, and attack speed.
